title: Vehicle fleet totals
prompt: Implement in `Solution`: abstract `Vehicle` with `public abstract double FuelFor(double km);`; `Car` returning `km / 15.0`; `Truck` returning `km / 8.0`; and `static double FleetFuel(List<Vehicle> fleet, double km)` summing `FuelFor(km)` over the fleet (null/empty fleet → 0).

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: FleetFuel aggregates through the abstract contract only.

tests.name: single
tests.code:
var solo = new List<Solution.Vehicle> { new Solution.Truck() };
Cj.Near(Solution.FleetFuel(solo, 80), 10.0, 1e-9, "80km truck burns 10");
tests.hint: A lone truck at 8 km/l covers 80 km on 10 liters.
